gui.director.tool.actor_scale.tip.2: Click an actor first, then drag the scale Gizmo

gui.director.tool.actor_look_at.desc: Set where the selected actor looks at the current time.

gui.director.tool.actor_pose.tip.2: Choose the edit target and bone operation in Properties; unsupported channels are unavailable

gui.director.tool.actor_path.tip.2: Paths are saved in Actors panel library; names must be unique

gui.director.tool.camera_path_edit.desc: Select and move camera path anchors with the Gizmo.
gui.director.tool.camera_path_edit.tip.2: Click a camera keyframe anchor in the world, then drag the Gizmo arrows

gui.director.selection_filter.advanced.e: No advanced rules are currently enabled
gui.director.tool_properties.embedded_ti: Tool properties are integrated into Properties
gui.director.tool_properties.embedded_hi: Use the Properties panel on the right to view and edit tool parameters. When a tool is selected, the Properties panel automatically shows its configuration.

gui.director.actor.bone_draft.hint: Auto-key applies on release. Otherwise use Apply. Esc or context changes cancel the draft. Shared asset edits affect every actor referencing it.
gui.director.actor.authoring.gizmo_pendi: Apply or cancel the bone Gizmo preview before editing numeric values.
gui.director.actor.authoring.unavailable: Asset authoring is read-only while playing, locked or muted, incompatible, or another pose draft is pending. Move the playhead into a compatible animation clip to edit.
gui.director.actor.assets.read_only: Pause playback and apply or cancel the current pose draft before changing animation assets.
gui.director.actor.assets.overlap: This interval overlaps %s animation clips. Existing clips will remain; the new clip may take playback priority.
gui.director.actor.assets.import_context: The project, actor or playhead changed while choosing the file. Import was cancelled.
gui.director.actor.path.target_library: Editing a library path. Existing actor routes remain independent.
gui.director.actor.path.target_route: Editing the selected actor's route instance. Library paths remain independent.
gui.director.actor.path.target_draft: Drawing a path draft. Apply creates an actor route; save to the library for reuse.
gui.director.actor.route.unavailable: Pause playback and select a valid unlocked actor route.
gui.director.actor.route.duration_hint: Once: traverse the full path during this clip; shorter duration moves faster. Loop and ping-pong repeat at the configured speed.
gui.director.actor.clip_inspector.title: Transform clip
gui.director.actor.clip_inspector.keyed: This clip uses keyframes. Select a timeline keyframe or edit the selected actor at the playhead. Endpoints and clip interpolation do not drive this animation.
gui.director.actor.clip_inspector.route_: Use the actor path tool to create a route clip for movement along a path.
gui.director.actor.clip_inspector.invali: Enter a complete, valid target entity UUID.
gui.director.actor.clip_inspector.unavai: Pause playback and select a valid, unlocked actor clip.
gui.director.actor.clip_inspector.cancel: The clip changed; the edit was cancelled.
gui.director.actor.behavior.invalid_time: The action start must be non-negative and its duration at least 0.1 seconds.
gui.director.actor.behavior.relation_run: Relations position an actor relative to its target. Circle-around currently uses a fixed angle. Mirror and object transfer are not implemented.
gui.director.actor.prop_event.title: Prop event
gui.director.actor.prop_event.preview_hi: Block and item props now have preview rendering on compatible humanoid rigs. Blocks default to half-block size. Offsets are socket-local; rotations use degrees. Both hands uses a midpoint without posing arms. Custom prop models are not implemented.
gui.director.actor.prop_event.trigger_hi: Events currently fire once on entering the clip. Legacy repeat flags do not change this behavior.
gui.director.actor.prop_event.cancelled: The edit target changed; the pending prop draft was cancelled.
gui.director.actor.prop_event.unavailabl: Pause playback and select a valid, unlocked actor event.
gui.director.actor.spawn_edit.title: Spawn clip
gui.director.actor.spawn_edit.invalid_ti: Spawn duration must be at least 0.1 seconds and times must be finite.
gui.director.actor.state_edit.runtime_hi: Sneaking, sprinting and invulnerability are not applied in preview yet. Existing values are preserved.
gui.director.actor.state_edit.visibility: Preview hides the actor at visibility ≤ 0.01; other values show it. Opacity fading is not implemented.
gui.director.actor.despawn_edit.title: Despawn clip
gui.director.actor.despawn_edit.hint: Despawn takes effect near the clip end: Hide sets visibility to zero; Remove marks the actor inactive.
gui.director.actor.pose_edit.sampling_hi: Edit the clip target pose: the first pose is held; subsequent clips blend from the preceding pose. Enabled regions override the base action and animation result.
gui.director.actor.pose_edit.unsupported: This inspector requires a compatible humanoid rig. Use this actor’s bone keyframes or procedural actions. Existing pose data is preserved.
gui.director.actor.pose_edit.keys_hint: This clip contains generic entity keyframes, which pose sampling does not read. This inspector edits the target pose and preserves those keys.
gui.director.actor.prop_event.scale_hint: Size range: 0.01–10. Blocks start at half a block; 2 makes one block. Hand pose uses the model’s hand settings, with left-hand settings for offhand; it does not pose the arms.
gui.director.actor.behavior.relation_gro: Relation placement projects onto ground and checks a straight segment from the actor’s track position. Obstacles stop it at a reachable point; an unsafe start hides preview. Height offsets do not create flight. Detection is limited to 64 blocks without pathfinding.
gui.director.actor.diagnostics.title: Preview diagnostics
gui.director.actor.diagnostics.reason.no: No standing surface below the path start, or terrain is not loaded.
Insufficient space at the path start.
gui.director.actor.diagnostics.reason.ro: The path is too long; split it into clips.
gui.director.actor.diagnostics.reason.gr: A steep ledge, gap, or unloaded terrain prevents further movement.
gui.director.actor.diagnostics.reason.ob: Insufficient space ahead; the actor stops before the obstacle.
gui.director.actor.diagnostics.reason.re: Relation movement is limited to the 64-block detection range.
gui.director.actor.diagnostics.reason.ro: The final animation position is invalid.
Vertical root movement was projected onto the ground; use a short jump.
gui.director.actor.diagnostics.reason.ju: Insufficient space overhead; the actor stays on the ground.
gui.director.actor.diagnostics.reason.re: The relation chain cycles or exceeds 128 levels; using the actor track position.
The relation target is missing, inactive, or hidden; using the actor track position.
gui.director.actor.diagnostics.reason.bi: The bound actor is missing; bind the track again.
gui.director.actor.diagnostics.reason.re: Relation terrain or actor collision dimensions are unavailable.
gui.director.actor.diagnostics.reason.ro: Path terrain or actor collision dimensions are unavailable.
gui.director.actor.diagnostics.reason.te: Terrain has changed or is unloaded; check the path again.
gui.director.actor.diagnostics.reason.pr: Cannot create the preview entity; check the world and actor type.
Invalid prop event parameters; the event was skipped.
The throw slot is empty; the throw was skipped.
The launch position or socket is unavailable; the prop cannot be previewed.
The actor rig does not support this prop socket.
Custom prop models cannot be previewed yet.
The prop item or block resource is missing.
gui.director.actor.tools.transform_hint: Click an actor to select it. Press on a handle to drag: axis, plane, or free movement at the center. Choose Rotate for rings. Esc cancels; release commits.
gui.director.actor.tools.look_hint: Use the target marker to edit gaze. Use Rotate to turn the whole actor.
gui.director.actor.tools.rotate_hint: Drag red/green/blue rings to rotate around X/Y/Z. Use the green Y ring to turn; Pose or Look at edits the head. Esc cancels; release commits.
gui.director.actor.tools.scale_hint: Drag an axis cube to scale one axis or a plane to scale two. Drag the center right to enlarge uniformly, left to shrink. Esc cancels; release commits.
gui.director.actor.authoring.numeric_ass: Select the animation asset target for numeric editing and keying. For quick poses, use the bone Gizmo or pose clip properties.
gui.director.actor.keys.choose_hint: Scene time / asset time. Choose a reference to drag; zoom in for dense keys. Right-click to choose again.
gui.director.actor.keys.selection_hint: Ctrl-click to toggle keys; drag a selected key to move the group. Right-click to choose a reference. Shared assets affect all references.
gui.director.actor.keys.drag_group: Move %s keys · asset time offset %ss. All shared references change; Esc cancels.
gui.director.actor.keys.marquee_hint: Select bone keys in the current clip. Ctrl adds; Esc cancels. Scrolling or zooming cancels this rectangle.
gui.director.actor.keys.marquee_referenc: Select an animation clip or keyframe reference first, then drag from empty space in its bone rows.
gui.director.actor.keys.paste_hint: The earliest copied key starts at the current clip asset time. Shared references change together. Collisions or out-of-range keys reject the whole paste.
gui.director.actor.keys.rejected: No changes submitted. Check source keys, collisions, duration and rig compatibility.
gui.director.actor.keys.interpolation_hi: Changes the transition from each selected key to the next: step, linear or smooth. Key times and pose values stay unchanged. All shared references update.
gui.director.actor.keys.time_hint: Set absolute asset time for one key, or a shared offset for multiple keys. Bounds or collisions reject the whole edit. Repeating clips do not support numeric moves yet.
gui.director.actor.keys.loop_seek_hint: Loop keys seek to the nearest occurrence. Time dragging and frame nudging are disabled for repeats. Keys outside the trimmed reference do not move the playhead.
gui.director.actor.detail.time: Scene time: %.3f s · Asset time: %.3f s
gui.director.actor.detail.shared: This asset has %d references; keyframe edits affect these references.
gui.director.actor.detail.select: Select an actor track or an animation reference on it.
gui.director.actor.detail.ambiguous: Multiple tracks are selected. Select one actor track or animation reference.
gui.director.actor.detail.unbound: This track has no actor binding. Bind an actor in track properties.
gui.director.actor.detail.missing_actor: The bound actor is missing. Check the track reference.
gui.director.actor.detail.unsupported_ri: This actor has no editable rig. Use its supported movement, look and behavior clips.
gui.director.actor.detail.no_animation: No animation reference at the playhead. Create or attach one explicitly in the animation asset panel.
gui.director.actor.detail.missing_asset: The animation asset is missing. Check the reference or import the asset again.
gui.director.actor.detail.incompatible: The animation rig is incompatible with this actor. Choose a matching asset.
gui.director.actor.detail.outside: The playhead is outside the selected animation reference. Move inside it to edit.
gui.director.actor.detail.read_only: Read only: check locks, muted states, playback or playhead scrubbing.
gui.director.actor.binding.hint: This actor has no track. You can inspect its properties. Create an empty track, then explicitly add spawn and behavior clips.
gui.director.actor.look_tool.reuse: Click a scene target or drag the marker to edit this clip without adding another. Changes affect the entire clip.
gui.director.actor.look_tool.pending: Choose a target: click a block surface to create one look-at clip. Escape, actor or playhead changes cancel.
gui.director.actor.look_tool.empty: No look-at clip. Scene clicks do not create one automatically. Create a look-at behavior first. Use Rotate to change actor orientation.
gui.director.actor.look_tool.select_owne: Bind and explicitly select an actor track first.
gui.director.actor.browser.hint: Find, create and select actors or groups here. Edit detailed settings and group authoring operations in the Properties panel.
gui.director.actor.player_model.hint: Choose the arm model matching your imported PNG. Default uses wide arms for imported skins.
gui.director.actor.transform_edit.initia: No transform animation: edits prefer the existing spawn initial state.
gui.director.actor.transform_edit.animat: Editing the existing transform animation; keyed clips write at the playhead.
gui.director.actor.root_keys.hint: Root keys stay in this clip. Once keyed, transform tools write at the playhead. Removing all keys restores the base or endpoint animation.
gui.director.actor.root_keys.readonly: Place the playhead inside an editable clip. Playback, locking or muting prevents key edits.
gui.director.actor.root_keys.smooth_conv: For an unkeyed smooth endpoint animation, first switch to linear interpolation or add keys at a boundary. Keyframes use interpolation per segment.
gui.director.actor.root_rows.ambiguous: Overlapping keys: select a specific actor clip first.
gui.director.actor.root_rows.drag: Root key time: %.3f s (release to apply, Esc to cancel)
